translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.105:1: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant
verses.105:2: Did He not frustrate their scheme
verses.105:3: For He sent against them flocks of birds
verses.105:4: that pelted them with stones of baked clay
verses.105:5: leaving them like chewed up straw
